state: DECLARED_NOT_EXECUTED (separate original-protocol lane; not a prerequisite for the matched adapted reference)

source.citation: Gasparin, Lukovic, Alippi. Deep Learning for Time Series Forecasting: The Electric Load Case. arXiv:1907.09207 (2019); CAAI Transactions on Intelligence Technology 7(1), 2022, doi:10.1049/cit2.12060
source.read_at: arXiv PDF v1: Section 7.1 (metrics), 7.2 (IHEPC use case), Table 3 (sample sizes), Table 4 (best configurations), Table 5 (results)
source.code_revision: NOT PUBLIC: no repository is named in the paper and none was found; the reproduction is from the text and tables

data.inputs: historical load values only (Sec. 7.2: 'using only historical load values')

resample.rule: mean of the 15 one-minute rows per slot

missing.rule: same time slot mean across years
missing.population: TRAIN YEARS ONLY (declared here; the paper says 'across the different years' without stating the split-side, so a train-only rule is the causal reading and any other reading is labelled FORENSIC)

split.test: the last year of measurements: 35040 = 365 x 96 windows (Table 3)
split.validation: one month set aside every five (Sec. 7.2)

TCN.source: Table 4, IHEPC column: L=8, k=2, M=32, lambda=0.005, dropout 0.1; the TCN row has NO n_H entry

ours_under_their_contract.model: ARCH-A modular core tcn_w with a 96-step MIMO head
ours_under_their_contract.note: a MATCHED entry inside the reproduction lane; its result is compared with the RE-EXECUTED references, not with Table 5

training.optimizer: not stated per model; Adam declared here as the installed default and recorded as an adaptation
training.selection: best configuration on validation, one evaluation on test

metrics.MAE: mean over N test pairs and the 96 steps of |yhat - y| (Sec. 7.1)
metrics.RMSE: sqrt of the mean over pairs and steps of (yhat - y)^2

added_here.naive: persistence at 96 steps on identical rows (the paper reports none)
added_here.MAE_z: MAE / sd of the train target (complementary column, separate row from the paper's metric)

published_reference_values_kw.use: reported beside the reproduction's own numbers as PUBLISHED; the discrepancy is declared, exact reproduction is never asserted without the missing pieces (optimizer, seeds, code)

acceptance_before_any_fit: resample count check reproduces Table 3 (35040 test, 103301 train)
imputation uses train-year statistics only; a test-year rule is labelled FORENSIC
metric formulas reproduce the paper's on a synthetic fixture with known values
persistence naive computed on identical rows
prefix invariance of the resampled series and of every input window

cost_plan.pilot: 200 updates per model, one seed, measures seconds per update on the resampled series
cost_plan.projection_rule: 10 repeats x 3 models x measured cost; must fit the round ceiling with 2000 s reserved for closure
cost_plan.hosts: one host per model family unless the workers run inside the accounted wrapper

governance: campaign and delivery per unit before any read; terminals through the outbox; closure by content in the warehouse; the contract id travels in the terminal tags
authorisation: this configuration does not authorise training; the campaign runs only after review of the RP65 packet

corrections.what: the RP65 transcription gave the TCN an n_H=50 that Table 4 does not contain (Musashi finding 5, checked against the primary PDF); the width of the TCN is M=32 filters with kernel 2 and 8 levels

ARTICLE_FACTS: Table 4 configurations (L, n_H for the recurrent models, M/k for the TCN, lambda, dropout)
15-minute resampling; 384-step window; 96-step MIMO horizon; MSE loss (eq. 21); 10 repeats; Table 5 values
EXPLICIT_ADAPTATIONS: Adam as the optimizer (not stated per model)
train-only imputation population (the article says 'across the different years')
our persistence naive and MAE_z columns, added beside the paper's metrics
UNKNOWN: optimizer and learning rate per model
fact_classes.reading: the article is NOT fully specified; Table 3 labels sample counts and is not an enumeration of admissible windows; a count match would not by itself prove an exact reproduction

expected_counts_check.rule: Table 3 counts are SAMPLE counts as the article labels them; the reproduction lane reports its own enumerated windows beside them and does NOT assert equality as proof of reproduction

adapted_matched_lane.what: GRU-MIMO family adapted to our one 60-minute target and the modular arm's inputs under the continuity recipe
adapted_matched_lane.is: literature-derived, measured under OUR contract; NOT a reproduction of Table 5
